summary.en-US: Shows backend response time, database name, server and queued jobs on MediaWiki wiki farm pages.

description.en-US:
MediaWikiDebugJS shows backend debugging details directly on MediaWiki pages.

When you visit a page on a recognized wiki farm, the extension adds a few lines near the page footer or user menu, depending on the skin:
• Backend response time
• Database name
• Server and CDN host that served the page
• Number of queued jobs on the wiki

MediaWiki is a trademark of the Wikimedia Foundation. This extension is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation.

version.approval_notes: No build step is needed to review this. The source in the repository is the extension as shipped, with no bundling or minification. content_script.js runs on all URLs because wiki farms use custom domains, and it exits immediately unless document.body has the mediawiki class and the page head or footer matches a known wiki farm host. It then sends a HEAD request to the current page and a request to the same site's api.php for statistics, and shows the results using textContent (no innerHTML). It requests no extension permissions, loads no remote code, and collects no data.
